expect.note: the inspector's /api/extract/ ground-truth endpoint appears in no module of src/browser/ except eval_adapter.py; its host reaches server.py's EXAMPLES (a start URL, which rule 6 allows and examples-cover-matrix requires) but never agent/planner/observe/resolver/verifier/judge; and every evals/**/*sec10k*.json that carries an expect.answer names the endpoint its ground truth came from

provenance: M41 deliverable 4, made checkable rather than promised. CLAUDE.md rule 6 allows a per-site ground-truth API endpoint, and M41 uses one: the inspector's `POST /api/extract/fixture` returns `doc_status`, `counts` and the per-item text that the `sec10k-*` and `live-sec10k-*` cases carry as `expect.answer`. What makes that legitimate and not a hole is the direction of the arrow — an executor that could ask the site for the answer would pass every case on that domain without reading the page, and nothing else in this suite would notice, because every guard the verifier runs (`grounded`, `not_a_dump`, `identity_anchors`) is satisfied by a value that IS on the page. Watched RED first three ways, one per conjunct: (1) the string `/api/extract/fixture` pasted into `src/browser/planner.py` -> {"endpoint_in_production_module": ["planner.py"]}; (2) the host pasted into `src/browser/agent.py` -> {"host_in_execution_policy": ["agent.py"]}; (3) the endpoint citation removed from `sec10k-doc-status-is-a-named-status.json` -> {"cases_not_citing_the_ground_truth_endpoint": ["sec10k-doc-status-is-a-named-status.json"]}. Pure code, no browser, no network.

triage.note: Same family as `support-matrix-cites-real-cases` and `adr-header-and-index`: it guards a discipline, not the product. Two ceilings, declared. It is a string scan, so an obfuscated reference (the host assembled from parts, the path built by f-string) passes it — the same ceiling every grep-shaped check in this repo has. And it scans `src/browser/*.py` only: the committed page snapshot under `fixtures/` is data, like `shop.html`, and evals/ is the side that is ALLOWED to know.
